name: SPOT bounded GMRES correction-activity census
purpose: Determine whether the frozen one-map production path actually reaches any nonzero-K MCGMRE correction update before defining a precision A/B at that update.
Count the existing primary, affine-RHS and Krylov operator roles and record every per-group KMAX vector without changing any floating-point arithmetic.
Use an exact structural result, not a numerical threshold, to choose the next smallest precision experiment.

observed_control_points: entry of each MCGMRE call and its matching normal exit
immediately before each existing primary, affine-RHS or Krylov MCGFL1 call
after KMAX is reset and before the existing affine-RHS and Krylov block, where the block-entry active-group mask is copied
after KMAX is complete and immediately before each existing PHIIN correction-update block

facts_not_available_from_parent_evidence: number of groups with KMAX greater than zero
number of affine-RHS and Krylov MCGFL1 calls

activation.syntax: standalone GMRA keyword in FLU input

reason: It is the exact parent input of the released STATIONARY RAW/EVAL/PRE/OFF capture.
The existing MOCA 2 tuple supplies the same-call primary RAW and source evidence without modifying its frozen schema.
ACCE 1 0 removes inner and outer FLU2AC accelerated steps from this first activity census.
The choice is fixed before observing GMRES activity and is not selected by a numerical result.

MCGMRE_controls.source: frozen TRACK MCCG-STATE(13), MCCG-STATE(3) and REAL-PARAM(1), also checked on the actual MCGMRE arguments

counter_semantics.role_event: one raw row and one 370-group 0/1 NCONV mask copied immediately before one existing MCGFL1 call; the row contains its MCGMRE call index, event index, role, global ITER, correction-block index and active-group count
counter_semantics.role_block_index: PRIMARY uses 0; AFFINE-RHS and KRYLOV use the current correction-block index created at block entry
counter_semantics.role_call_count: increment once immediately before the corresponding existing MCGFL1 call
counter_semantics.role_active_group_count: add COUNT(NCONV) at that same call site
counter_semantics.correction_block: one visit to the existing KMAX-complete point immediately before the PHIIN update loop
counter_semantics.group_block: one physical group in one correction block
counter_semantics.block_entry_active_mask: the exact NCONV mask copied after KMAX is reset and before the existing affine-RHS and Krylov block
counter_semantics.block_active_group_count: the exact integer sum of the corresponding block-entry active mask
counter_semantics.nonzero_K_group_block: a group-block whose stored KMAX is greater than zero
counter_semantics.sum_K: exact integer sum of every stored KMAX over every group-block
counter_semantics.K_histogram: eleven exact integer bins for KMAX=0..10 over every stored group-block
counter_semantics.inactive_group_rule: a block-entry inactive group has active-mask 0 and KMAX 0; an active group may retain KMAX 0 only when the existing iteration limit prevents every Krylov call in that block
counter_semantics.role_event_order: MCGMRE call order, then role-event order within the call
counter_semantics.block_event_order: MCGMRE call order, then correction-block order within the call, then physical group 1..370

records.name: NGIND
records.meaning: physical group identifier in storage order; exactly 1..370

records.name: ROLE-CALLS
records.meaning: PRIMARY, AFFINE-RHS and KRYLOV MCGFL1 call counts

records.name: ROLE-GROUPS
records.meaning: sum of active groups at the same three role call sites

records.name: ROLE-ACTIVE
records.meaning: 0/1 NCONV mask at the corresponding role call site in event-major then physical-group order

records.name: K-HISTOGRAM
records.meaning: exact bins KMAX=0..10 over all stored group-block rows

records.name: BLOCK-ACTIVE
records.meaning: 0/1 block-entry active mask in block-major then physical-group order

records.name: BLOCK-KMAX
records.meaning: KMAX in block-major then physical-group order

audit_record_contract.zero_call_encoding: CALL-META is absent if and only if MCGMRE-entry-count is zero; a valid frozen production census instead requires exactly one row with normal-exit-flag 1
audit_record_contract.zero_role_event_encoding: ROLE-EVENTS and ROLE-ACTIVE are both absent if and only if total-role-call-count is zero; otherwise both are present at their exact declared lengths
audit_record_contract.zero_block_encoding: BLOCK-META, BLOCK-ACTIVE and BLOCK-KMAX are all absent if and only if correction-block-count is zero; otherwise all three are present at their exact declared lengths
exact_closure: ROLE-EVENTS active-group-count equals the sum of its 370 ROLE-ACTIVE values, from which ROLE-CALLS and ROLE-GROUPS are independently recomputed
CALL-META independently closes MCGMRE entry-count, exit-count, per-call role-event counts, per-call correction-block counts and every raw event or block call index

call indexes and within-call event and block indexes are contiguous from 1; every normal-exit flag is 1; every role is in 1..3; every active-group count is in 0..370; and global ITER is positive and nondecreasing within each call
BLOCK-META row count equals correction-block-count and each active-group-count equals the sum of its 370 BLOCK-ACTIVE values
each BLOCK-ACTIVE value is 0 or 1, each BLOCK-KMAX value is in 0..10, and active-mask 0 implies KMAX 0
for each block and physical group, BLOCK-KMAX equals the exact count of active values in that block's KRYLOV ROLE-ACTIVE masks
within each block the first KRYLOV ROLE-ACTIVE mask equals BLOCK-ACTIVE and later KRYLOV masks can change only from 1 to 0, never from 0 to 1
Krylov ROLE-GROUPS equals sum-K and Krylov ROLE-CALLS equals the sum over blocks of the block maximum KMAX
if a block maximum KMAX is positive then every block-entry active group has KMAX at least 1; if the block maximum is zero then every KMAX in that block is zero
K-HISTOGRAM sums to group-block-row-count and independently determines nonzero-K-group-block-count, sum-K and max-K
max-K is exactly zero when no positive KMAX row exists
STATE-VECTOR fields 9..20 exactly repeat the independently closed counts, fields 21..22 exactly record MCGMRE MAXI=20 and ERRTOL binary32 bits 3727C5AC, and fields 23..24 are zero
audit_record_contract.write_policy: create only STATE-VECTOR with INCOMPLETE status at begin; retain events in integer memory; after normal FLU return write every final ledger record once and publish COMPLETE as the last write; never read any audit value back into the solver

implementation_strategy.instrumented_source_tree: a fresh clean Git archive of frozen_parent_commit plus one tracked validation-only overlay
overlay_scope: add one independent GMRES integer-counter and Ganlib-sink module
add GMRA parsing and propagation without changing the existing MOCA semantics
insert read-only entry, role, block and exit counter calls around existing MCGMRE statements
add only the build dependency required by the new validation-only module
forbidden_overlay_changes: any floating-point declaration, expression, assignment or comparison in the solver
any existing branch condition, iteration bound, stopping rule or operator call
any production XSM record outside SPOT-GMR-AUD
required_freeze: overlay manifest and every overlay source SHA256
one implementation manifest covering this protocol checker, overlay, clean-archive builder, module state tests, fixture writer, Ganlib checker, log normalizer, preflight runner and contract checker
instrumented executable SHA256 and symbol census
implementation_strategy.live_workspace_check: all tracked src files equal frozen_parent_commit before and after every build and run

required_implementation_properties: The legacy SPOMOC_AUDIT source and SPOT-MOC-AUD schema remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
GMRA is default off and fails closed unless MOCA 2 and the complete locked solver path, including MCGMRE MAXI=20, ERRTOL bits 3727C5AC and NSTART=10, are active.
OFF executes the original MCGMRE floating-point statements in their original order and reproduces the released OFF output and normalized scientific log exactly.
ON adds only integer counter updates and writes only below SPOT-GMR-AUD; it adds no floating-point expression, solver branch, stopping test or operator call.
Counter procedures receive solver arrays as read-only intent(in) data and return no value used by production code.

The valid frozen path permits exactly one MCGMRE entry and one matching normal exit; a second entry fails closed; role counts equal the instrumented call-site census, every block-entry mask is copied before the existing affine-RHS and Krylov block, and every completed KMAX vector is recorded before the unchanged update loop.
Publication occurs only after MCGMRE and FLU return normally and the exact record identities close.
No relaxation, clipping, fitted factor, flux floor, model term or empirical parameter is introduced.
required_no_transport_tests: default-off state-machine identity and zero mutation
duplicate GMRA, GMRA without MOCA 2 and every unlocked context fails closed
hand-constructed zero-role-event, zero-block, mixed-role, mixed-KMAX and multiple-block fixtures
independent recomputation from CALL-META, ROLE-ACTIVE and block rows of entry/exit, role counts, active-group sums, nonzero group-blocks, sum-K, max-K and every histogram bin
per-block per-group KMAX reconstruction from KRYLOV ROLE-ACTIVE, first-mask identity and monotone 1-to-0 tamper rejection
inactive group with nonzero KMAX, active group with out-of-range KMAX, missing exit and mismatched entry-exit rejection
missing required-present, unexpected zero-case, duplicate, reordered, extra, wrong-type and wrong-length audit record rejection
multi-block and physical-group sentinels prove block-major group order
two synthetic executions and two independent checker executions are byte identical
reader source and object have no LCM mutation outside a test-only fixture and no Dragon, FLU, MOC or solver dependency

bounded_production_run.required_before_execution: a separately committed and hash-frozen run, checking, atomic-publication and result-receipt protocol

ON_log_difference_whitelist.deck_listing: replace exactly one ' MOCA 2 GMRA ;' with ' MOCA 2 ;     ' on source line 0028, restoring the five fixed-width CLE-2000 padding columns
ON_log_difference_whitelist.execution_echo: replace exactly one ' MOCA 2 GMRA ;' with ' MOCA 2 ;     ' on echoed source line 0028, restoring the five fixed-width CLE-2000 padding columns

future_publication_requirements: RUN_GMRES_ACTIVITY=1 remains unauthorized until the separate run and publication protocol and complete implementation manifest are committed and hash frozen
publish into a new no-overwrite artifact path through a same-filesystem temporary directory and atomic rename only after all checks pass
reject symlinks, special files, missing or extra payloads and any manifest mismatch before publication
bind the run protocol, complete implementation manifest, immutable inputs, executable identity, raw ledgers, checker outputs, classification and interpretation limits in the final result receipt
required_production_checks: All immutable input hashes are identical before and after every process.
Every process starts from a distinct regular byte-identical copy of the same frozen PRE.
Fresh OFF reproduces LEGACY_OFF_XSM byte for byte and its scientific log reproduces LEGACY_OFF_LOG after only the already frozen CPU telemetry normalization.

Each fresh ON reproduces LEGACY_ON_XSM outside SPOT-GMR-AUD; after the frozen CPU normalization and exactly the two declared source-line GMRA token removals, its full log equals LEGACY_ON_LOG byte for byte with no added activity line.
The two ON outputs, logs and complete activity ledgers reproduce one another exactly.
The existing SPOT-MOC-AUD tuple and all non-audit scientific records are unchanged.

The full log and CALL-META jointly prove exactly one outer iteration, thermal iteration, DOORFV call, MCCGF call, MCGMRE entry, matching normal exit and at least one PRIMARY role event on each valid ON run.
A Ganlib-only read-only checker independently recomputes every aggregate from CALL-META, ROLE-EVENTS, ROLE-ACTIVE, BLOCK-META, BLOCK-ACTIVE and BLOCK-KMAX.
The checker proves ROLE-CALLS, ROLE-GROUPS, STATE-VECTOR, K-HISTOGRAM and the exact Krylov-to-KMAX cross identities and retains every raw event, mask and block row.
Source and binary audits prove zero added operator application, no solver feedback and no production dependency in the independent checker.

classification.zero_definition: all contracts pass and nonzero-K-group-block-count equals exactly zero
classification.nonzero_definition: all contracts pass and nonzero-K-group-block-count is an exact positive integer

next_decision.INVALID: stop; repair only the evidence or implementation contract and rerun the same bounded census
next_decision.VALID-GMRES-UPDATE-ACTIVE: freeze, but do not yet run, the default-off GMRES correction-accumulation precision A/B
next_decision.VALID-GMRES-UPDATE-INACTIVE: do not implement the inactive GMRES update experiment; next freeze an always-executed MCGFCS source-arithmetic precision A/B
